meta.name: SHUDDHO Global Foods Database
meta.basis: All nutrient values are per 100 g unless stated otherwise.
meta.micronutrient_policy: Micronutrients are null in this V1 file rather than estimated or fabricated.
meta.provenance_note: Records preserve USDA FoodData Central FDC IDs and descriptions. This curated layer is intended as a static, API-free supplement to the Bangladesh food-composition database.
